feed.title: Apple Says iPhone 18 Pro Max Units That Lost AT&T Service Need Replacement, Not a Fix
feed.summary: Apple has confirmed that a cellular connectivity issue affecting some iPhone 18 Pro Max devices on AT&T's network requires unit replacement rather than a software fix for already-affected phones. While iOS 27.0.1 and a carrier settings update act as preventive measures, they cannot restore service on devices already in SOS mode. The cause of the fault, which primarily impacts the US iPhone 18 Pro Max model using a Qualcomm modem, has not been disclosed, and Apple states only a "small number" of users are affected despite thousands of complaints.

feed.title: Will Deere's (DE) Shift Toward Construction and Small Equipment Reshape Its Precision Tech Narrative?

feed.title: T-Mobile vs. Verizon: Two Very Different Ways to Own the Same Industry
feed.summary: T-Mobile and Verizon are pursuing contrasting strategies to dominate the telecommunications industry, with T-Mobile focusing on subscriber growth and market share expansion, while Verizon prioritizes income investors with a high dividend yield and a turnaround plan. T-Mobile's strategy has led to significant postpaid service revenue growth, especially with premium plans and expansion into rural markets. Verizon, conversely, has cut subsidies and seen a surge in fiber connections, but its falling ARPA and debt levels mean its turnaround is not yet proven.

feed.title: Eni (E) and Repsol Explore Partial Divestment of Perla Gas Field Stakes Amid Financing Drive
feed.summary: Eni and Repsol are considering selling parts of their combined 50% stake in Venezuela's Perla natural gas field to secure capital for accelerated development. feed.title: Fortinet Turned $1,000 Into $24,579 in a Decade While the S&P 500 Delivered $3,585
feed.summary: Fortinet (FTNT) saw a $1,000 investment grow to $24,579 in a decade, significantly outperforming the S&P 500's return of $3,585 over the same period, attributed to its strategy of building custom chips and maintaining founder leadership. The company's success is driven by its FortiGate firewall, expansion into cloud-delivered and AI-driven security, and a recent surge in product revenue and billings due to AI workload security upgrades.
